records.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Project Plan
records.content: This record outlines the comprehensive plan for starting a small vegetable garden in a backyard with a focus on beginner-friendly vegetables, garden layout, supplies, and other considerations.
records.description: A detailed project plan for initiating a beginner vegetable garden with specific sections for layout, supplies, and other planning aspects.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Planning a small garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, which is a recommended size for beginners. The chosen location receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily, which is generally sufficient for most vegetables like tomatoes and lettuce. Confirmation needed if 6 hours is optimal for selected crops.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content:
- Soil
- Containers or materials for raised bed (4ft x 8ft)
- Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- Basic gardening tools (shovel, trowel, gloves)
- Watering system (considering simple drip irrigation)

sections.heading: General Planting Considerations
sections.content: Aim to have everything planted by early May. Research companion planting options, such as planting basil near tomatoes for mutual benefit. Address pest concerns, especially rabbits, by exploring fencing options and natural pest deterrents instead of chemicals.

sections.heading: Vegetables for Beginners in Zone 7b
sections.content:
Suitable vegetables for beginner gardeners in USDA Hardiness Zone 7b (average minimum winter temperatures of 5 to 10°F) include:
- Tomatoes: Easy to grow, require full sun (6+ hours), plant after last frost (typically mid-April in 7b).
- Lettuce: Quick-growing, can be planted early spring or fall, tolerates partial shade.
- Radishes: Very easy and fast-growing, ideal for beginners, plant in early spring.
- Carrots: Simple to grow, plant in loose soil in spring or fall.
- Beans: Easy to cultivate, plant after last frost for summer harvest.
Zone 7b has a growing season from mid-April to mid-October, allowing for multiple plantings of fast-growing crops.

records.title: Planting Calendar for Zone 7b Vegetable Garden
records.content: This record provides a seasonal planting schedule for vegetables in a zone 7b garden to ensure timely planting and harvesting.
records.description: A dedicated calendar for planting and harvesting times for a beginner vegetable garden in zone 7b.

sections.heading: Spring Planting (March - April)
sections.content:
- Early March: Lettuce, Radishes (indoors or under protection)
- Mid-April (after last frost): Tomatoes (transplants), Beans, Carrots

sections.heading: Summer Planting (May - June)
sections.content:
- May: Second planting of Lettuce for continuous harvest
- June: Beans for late summer harvest

sections.heading: Fall Planting (August - September)
sections.content:
- August: Lettuce, Radishes for fall harvest
- September: Carrots for late fall or early winter harvest
